_meta.description: Tier 3 — IAS 37 / RJ 252 Provisions, Contingent Liabilities and Contingent Assets. Nine new schemas (Provision, ProvisionMovement, ContingentLiability, PensioenvoorzieningDetail, JubileumvoorzieningDetail, HerstructureringsvoorzieningDetail, GarantievoorzieningDetail, MilieuvoorzieningDetail, ClaimsVoorzieningDetail) declaring the recognition, measurement (best-estimate + range, discontering), period roll-forward, type-specific extensions and jaarrekening disclosure surface entirely as declarative metadata per ADR-031: schema fields + x-openregister-lifecycle (draft → active on Provision with materiality + three-criteria gating; open → closed on ProvisionMovement; draft → published on ContingentLiability) + x-openregister-aggregations (provisionRollForward roll-forward, provisionDisclosureGeneration disclosure-table) + x-openregister-calculations (discountedValue, unwindingOfDiscount). Lifecycle preconditions that the declarative requires: clause cannot yet express are referenced as OCA\Shillinq\Lifecycle\ProvisionGuard::<method> (ADR-031 exception path; fail-closed; real OpenRegister ObjectService API per ADR-022). REQ-PROV-001 enforces three-criteria recognition at the schema validator level (legalOrConstructiveObligation enum, obligatingEvent text, probabilityOfOutflow ≥ 0.5, bestEstimate + bestEstimateRationale). REQ-PROV-005 blocks Herstructureringsvoorziening recognition when detailedPlanDate post-dates balansdatum. REQ-PROV-006 blocks Claims-voorziening when legalAdviceMemo FK is missing. REQ-PROV-018 + REQ-PROV-010 require peer-reviewer + CFO sign-off above EUR 100K / 1 % balanstotaal. Seeds ship three Provision specimen records (garantie, milieu, claims), two ContingentLiability specimen records (fiscaal geschil, borgstelling) and one ProvisionMovement template per design.md; operators customise per administration on first use. No PHP valuation service is authored.

Provision.title: Provision
Provision.description: Core polymorphic IAS 37 / RJ 252 voorziening record (REQ-PROV-001, REQ-PROV-002, REQ-PROV-003, REQ-PROV-007, REQ-PROV-010, REQ-PROV-018). Carries the three-criteria recognition (legal/constructive obligation + obligating event + probabilityOfOutflow > 0.5 + bestEstimate), the sensitivity range (rangeLow / rangeHigh), the expectedTiming horizon split, the disconteringsvoet + discounted value when material future timing applies, the linkedAccount FK into the chart of accounts, the peer-review + CFO audit trail and the optional FK into one of six type-specific detail registers (pensioen, jubileum, herstructurering, garantie, milieu, claims). probabilityOfOutflow ≤ 0.5 routes to ContingentLiability instead.

provisionType.description: Discriminator selecting which type-specific detail register applies (REQ-PROV-001).
provisionType.title: Provision Type

recognitionDate.description: Date the provision was first recognised (REQ-PROV-001).
recognitionDate.title: Recognition Date

recognitionRationale.description: Narrative explaining why the three IAS 37 / RJ 252 criteria are satisfied (REQ-PROV-001).
recognitionRationale.example: Garantieclausule in algemene voorwaarden + 1.5% historische claim-rate
recognitionRationale.title: Recognition Rationale

obligatingEvent.description: Past event that created the obligation (IAS 37 §17, REQ-PROV-001).
obligatingEvent.example: Verkoop goederen met waarborg 12 maanden per contractvoorwaarden
obligatingEvent.title: Obligating Event

probabilityOfOutflow.description: Decimal 0–1 probability of outflow of economic resources (IAS 37 §23, REQ-PROV-001, REQ-PROV-007). Must be > 0.5 for balance-sheet recognition; 0.05–0.5 routes to ContingentLiability; ≤ 0.05 is remote.
probabilityOfOutflow.title: Probability Of Outflow

bestEstimate.description: Management's best estimate of the outflow in EUR (IAS 37 §36, REQ-PROV-002). REQ-PROV-018 triggers peer-review when > EUR 100K or > 1% of prior-year balance total.
bestEstimate.title: Best Estimate

bestEstimateRationale.description: Narrative documenting the methodology and sources used to arrive at bestEstimate (REQ-PROV-002).
bestEstimateRationale.example: EUR 12M omzet × 1.5% historische claim-rate (5-jaar gemiddelde) - reeds geleverde claims
bestEstimateRationale.title: Best Estimate Rationale

rangeLow.description: Lower bound of the sensitivity range in EUR (IAS 37 §39, REQ-PROV-002).
rangeLow.title: Range Low

rangeHigh.description: Upper bound of the sensitivity range in EUR (IAS 37 §39, REQ-PROV-002).
rangeHigh.title: Range High

expectedTiming.description: Horizon split of expected outflows (REQ-PROV-003, REQ-PROV-017). longTerm > 0 triggers REQ-PROV-003 disconteringsvoet.

shortTerm.description: Expected outflow within 1 year in EUR.
shortTerm.title: Short Term

expectedTiming.title: Expected Timing

discountRateApplied.description: Risk-adjusted disconteringsvoet applied when expected timing > 1 year is material (IAS 37 §45, REQ-PROV-003). Pre-tax rate reflecting current market assessments + risk specific to the liability.
discountRateApplied.title: Discount Rate Applied

discountedValue.description: Present value of bestEstimate after disconteringsvoet (REQ-PROV-003, REQ-PROV-017). Computed via x-openregister-calculations.discountedValue.
discountedValue.title: Discounted Value

linkedAccount.description: FK to balance-sheet account code in bookkeeping-chart-of-accounts (REQ-PROV-016).
linkedAccount.title: Linked Account

expert.description: External expert (actuary, environmental bureau, legal counsel) consulted (REQ-PROV-006, REQ-PROV-013).
expert.title: Expert

peerReviewer.description: FK to peer-reviewer person (other than recognition author) (REQ-PROV-010, REQ-PROV-018).
peerReviewer.title: Peer Reviewer

cfoApprover.description: FK to CFO / audit-committee approver for material provisions (REQ-PROV-018).
cfoApprover.title: Cfo Approver

cfoApprovalDate.description: Date CFO / audit committee approved the recognition (REQ-PROV-018).
cfoApprovalDate.title: Cfo Approval Date

priorYearBalanceTotal.description: Prior-year balanstotaal in EUR used by the schema validator to apply the 1% materiality test (REQ-PROV-018).
priorYearBalanceTotal.title: Prior Year Balance Total

linkedPensionProvisionDetail.description: FK to the PensioenvoorzieningDetail when provisionType=pensioen (REQ-PROV-014).
linkedPensionProvisionDetail.title: Linked Pensioenvoorziening Detail

linkedAnniversaryProvisionDetail.description: FK to the JubileumvoorzieningDetail when provisionType=jubileum (REQ-PROV-011).
linkedAnniversaryProvisionDetail.title: Linked Jubileumvoorziening Detail

linkedRestructuringProvisionDetail.description: FK to the HerstructureringsvoorzieningDetail when provisionType=herstructurering (REQ-PROV-005).
linkedRestructuringProvisionDetail.title: Linked Herstructureringsvoorziening Detail

linkedGuaranteeProvisionDetail.description: FK to the GarantievoorzieningDetail when provisionType=garantie (REQ-PROV-012).
linkedGuaranteeProvisionDetail.title: Linked Garantievoorziening Detail

linkedEnvironmentProvisionDetail.description: FK to the MilieuvoorzieningDetail when provisionType=milieu (REQ-PROV-013).
linkedEnvironmentProvisionDetail.title: Linked Milieuvoorziening Detail

linkedClaimsProvisionDetail.description: FK to the ClaimsVoorzieningDetail when provisionType=claims (REQ-PROV-006).
linkedClaimsProvisionDetail.title: Linked Claims Voorziening Detail

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

discountedValue.description: Present value of bestEstimate per IAS 37 §45 (REQ-PROV-003). discountedValue = bestEstimate / (1 + discountRateApplied)^yearsToOutflow. Computed only when discountRateApplied > 0; nullable otherwise.
discountedValue.expression: discountRateApplied > 0 ? bestEstimate / pow(1 + discountRateApplied, yearsToOutflow) : null

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Editable. Provision being recognised; three-criteria and peer review under review.

active.label: Active
active.description: Recognised on balance sheet; movements tracked per period (REQ-PROV-004).

released.label: Released
released.description: Provision fully used or released; no further movements expected.

activate.label: Activate provision
activate.description: Recognise on balance sheet once three criteria + peer review (and CFO sign-off when material) are complete (REQ-PROV-001, REQ-PROV-005, REQ-PROV-006, REQ-PROV-010, REQ-PROV-018).

startHerwaardering.label: Start annual herwaardering
startHerwaardering.description: Open the provision for annual balansdatum herwaardering (REQ-PROV-009).

completeHerwaardering.label: Complete herwaardering
completeHerwaardering.description: Lock the herwaardering; any estimate change recorded prospectively as effectOfChangeInEstimate on the next ProvisionMovement (REQ-PROV-009, REQ-PROV-019).

release.label: Release provision
release.description: Provision fully utilised or released; no further movements expected.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Provision is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

ProvisionMovement.title: Provision Movement
ProvisionMovement.description: Per-period roll-forward of a single Provision per IAS 37 §84 (REQ-PROV-004, REQ-PROV-016, REQ-PROV-017, REQ-PROV-019). Carries the opening balance, dotation, onttrekking, vrijval, unwinding of discount, effect of change in discount rate, effect of change in estimate, translation differences and the computed closing balance. Once status=closed the record is immutable; corrections are recorded as prospective effectOfChangeInEstimate on the next open period (REQ-PROV-019 / IAS 8). linkedJournalEntries connect every bucket to the GL journal entries that posted it.

period.description: Period identifier in YYYY-MM or YYYY format (REQ-PROV-004).
period.title: Period

openingBalance.description: Carrying amount at the start of the period in EUR (REQ-PROV-004).
openingBalance.title: Opening Balance

additions.description: Dotaties charged to the P&L this period in EUR (REQ-PROV-004).
additions.title: Additions

additionsAcquired.description: Additions acquired via business combination in EUR (IAS 37 §84(b)).
additionsAcquired.title: Additions Acquired

usedDuringPeriod.description: Amount used (paid / settled) during the period in EUR (REQ-PROV-004).
usedDuringPeriod.title: Used During Period

releasedUnused.description: Vrijval — amount released because the obligation no longer exists or has been reduced (REQ-PROV-004).
releasedUnused.title: Released Unused

unwindingOfDiscount.description: Unwinding of discount as rente bijgeboekt in EUR (REQ-PROV-017). unwindingOfDiscount = max(0, priorDiscountedValue * discountRateApplied).
unwindingOfDiscount.title: Unwinding Of Discount

effectOfChangeInDiscountRate.description: P&L / discountedValue effect of changing the disconteringsvoet (REQ-PROV-003).
effectOfChangeInDiscountRate.title: Effect Of Change In Discount Rate

effectOfChangeInEstimate.description: Prospective schattingswijziging per IAS 8 (REQ-PROV-019). Corrections to closed periods are recorded here in the next open period rather than retroactively adjusted.
effectOfChangeInEstimate.title: Effect Of Change In Estimate

translationDifferences.description: FX translation differences for foreign-currency provisions (out of scope of v1, kept for parity with IAS 37 §84(e)).
translationDifferences.title: Translation Differences

closingBalance.description: Carrying amount at the end of the period in EUR (REQ-PROV-004). closingBalance = openingBalance + additions + additionsAcquired - usedDuringPeriod - releasedUnused + unwindingOfDiscount + effectOfChangeInDiscountRate + effectOfChangeInEstimate + translationDifferences.
closingBalance.title: Closing Balance

linkedJournalEntries.description: FKs into the GL journal entries that posted every bucket of this movement (REQ-PROV-016).
linkedJournalEntries.title: Linked Journal Entries

narrative.description: Free-form explanation of the period's mutation (e.g. why effectOfChangeInEstimate is non-zero) (REQ-PROV-019).
narrative.title: Narrative

status.description: Movement lifecycle. Once status=closed the record is immutable per REQ-PROV-004 / REQ-PROV-019.
status.title: Status

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

closingBalance.description: Roll-forward closing balance per IAS 37 §84 (REQ-PROV-004). Sums every movement bucket; immutable once status=closed.
closingBalance.expression: openingBalance + additions + additionsAcquired - usedDuringPeriod - releasedUnused + unwindingOfDiscount + effectOfChangeInDiscountRate + effectOfChangeInEstimate + translationDifferences

open.label: Open
open.description: Editable during the period; buckets accept dotaties, onttrekkingen, vrijvallen, unwinding.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: Period closed; record is immutable. Corrections recorded as prospective effectOfChangeInEstimate on the next open period (REQ-PROV-019).

close.label: Close period
close.description: Lock the movement once the period close is reconciled to GL (REQ-PROV-004, REQ-PROV-016).

provisionRollForward.description: Declarative roll-forward emitting ProvisionMovement records per Provision per period (REQ-PROV-004). Closing of period N is the opening of period N+1. When the OpenRegister aggregation engine cannot express the prior-period carry, the same arithmetic is recomputed from the prior ProvisionMovement closing balance via the real ObjectService API.

closingBalance.expression: openingBalance + additions + additionsAcquired - usedDuringPeriod - releasedUnused + unwindingOfDiscount + effectOfChangeInDiscountRate + effectOfChangeInEstimate + translationDifferences

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Provision Movement is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

ContingentLiability.title: Contingent Liability
ContingentLiability.description: Disclosure-only record for niet-uit-de-balans-blijkende verplichtingen per IAS 37 §27–30 / RJ 252 §297–300 (REQ-PROV-007, REQ-PROV-015). Used when probability of outflow is between 5% and 50% (`possible`) or when probability exceeds 50% but no reliable estimate is available. probability ≤ 5% (`remote`) is kept here for completeness but excluded from jaarrekening notes per IAS 37 §86.

description.description: Human-readable description of the contingent liability (REQ-PROV-015).
description.title: Description

estimatedAmount.description: Estimated amount when available; null when no reliable estimate (IAS 37 §86, REQ-PROV-015).
estimatedAmount.title: Estimated Amount

probabilityCategory.description: Probability bucket per IAS 37 (REQ-PROV-007, REQ-PROV-015). possible = 5%–50%; probable-but-no-reliable-estimate = > 50% but estimate unreliable; remote = ≤ 5% (not disclosed).
probabilityCategory.title: Probability Category

expectedTiming.description: Expected timing of the outflow as free-form text (REQ-PROV-015).
expectedTiming.title: Expected Timing

disclosureNarrative.description: Narrative for the jaarrekening note 'Niet uit de balans blijkende verplichtingen' (IAS 37 §86, RJ 252 §407, REQ-PROV-008, REQ-PROV-015).
disclosureNarrative.example: Het belastingdienst heeft een voorstellingscorrectie opgelegd. Naar schatting van onze belastingadviseur is er 30% kans dat deze in hoger beroep zal worden gehandhaafd. Geen reliable estimate beschikbaar.
disclosureNarrative.title: Disclosure Narrative

relatedParty.description: FK to the related party / organisation, when applicable (REQ-PROV-015).
relatedParty.title: Related Party

linkedExpertReport.description: FK into docudesk for the expert / legal report supporting the disclosure.
linkedExpertReport.title: Linked Expert Report

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

published.label: Published
published.description: Included in jaarrekening toelichting 'Niet uit de balans blijkende verplichtingen'.

publish.label: Publish to jaarrekening
publish.description: Publish the contingent liability into the jaarrekening notes (REQ-PROV-015).

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Contingent Liability is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

PensioenvoorzieningDetail.title: Pensioenvoorziening Detail
PensioenvoorzieningDetail.description: Type-specific detail register for eigen-beheer pensioenvoorzieningen (REQ-PROV-014). FK back to a Provision with provisionType=pensioen. Detailed actuariële measurement (PUC, mortality, deelnemerstelling) is handled by bookkeeping-pension-ias19; this register captures the cross-reference and the high-level assumptions visible from the IAS 37 perspective.

actuarialMethod.description: Actuarial method (PUC mandatory for DB plans per IAS 19, REQ-PROV-014).
actuarialMethod.title: Actuarial Method

salaryGrowthAssumption.description: Salary growth assumption used in the actuariële berekening.
salaryGrowthAssumption.title: Salary Growth Assumption

linkedActuaryReport.description: FK into docudesk for the actuariële rapport.
linkedActuaryReport.title: Linked Actuary Report

linkedPensionPlan.description: FK to a PensionPlan in bookkeeping-pension-ias19 when the entity uses both registers.
linkedPensionPlan.title: Linked Pension Plan

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Pensioenvoorziening Detail is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

JubileumvoorzieningDetail.title: Jubileumvoorziening Detail
JubileumvoorzieningDetail.description: Type-specific detail register for CAO-jubileumuitkeringen (25- en 40-jaars) per RJ 252 §360 (REQ-PROV-011). FK back to a Provision with provisionType=jubileum. Records the CAO reference + populatie + turnover-gecorrigeerde milestone probability.

eligibleEmployees.description: Number of employees eligible for a jubileumuitkering (REQ-PROV-011).
eligibleEmployees.title: Eligible Employees

averageServiceYears.description: Average service years across the eligible population (REQ-PROV-011).
averageServiceYears.title: Average Service Years

probabilityOfReachingMilestone.description: Turnover-gecorrigeerde probability of reaching the milestone (REQ-PROV-011).
probabilityOfReachingMilestone.title: Probability Of Reaching Milestone

actuarialModel.description: Methodology used to derive the best estimate (e.g. 'Simplified: active × accrual rate × avg-salary' or 'PUC') (REQ-PROV-011).
actuarialModel.title: Actuarial Model

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Jubileumvoorziening Detail is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

HerstructureringsvoorzieningDetail.title: Herstructureringsvoorziening Detail
HerstructureringsvoorzieningDetail.description: Type-specific detail register for herstructureringsvoorzieningen (IAS 37 §72–83 / RJ 252 §327–336, REQ-PROV-005). FK back to a Provision with provisionType=herstructurering. detailedPlanDate MUST be on or before balansdatum and planCommunicatedTo MUST list the affected parties; the activation guard enforces both before status=active.

detailedPlanDate.description: Date the detailed plan was finalised. MUST be ≤ balansdatum per IAS 37 §72 (REQ-PROV-005).
detailedPlanDate.title: Detailed Plan Date

balanceDate.description: Balansdatum against which the §72 timeliness criterion is evaluated (REQ-PROV-005). The activation guard compares detailedPlanDate against this date.
balanceDate.title: Balance Date

planCommunicatedTo.description: List of affected parties to whom the plan has been communicated (HR, unions, employee reps) (REQ-PROV-005).
planCommunicatedTo.title: Plan Communicated To

affectedEmployees.description: Number of employees affected by the restructuring (REQ-PROV-005).
affectedEmployees.title: Affected Employees

expectedRedundancyPayments.description: Expected redundancy / severance payments in EUR (REQ-PROV-005).
expectedRedundancyPayments.title: Expected Redundancy Payments

expectedLeaseExitCosts.description: Expected onerous-lease exit costs in EUR (IFRS 16, REQ-PROV-005).
expectedLeaseExitCosts.title: Expected Lease Exit Costs

reorganisationPlanDocument.description: FK into docudesk for the reorganisatieplan document (REQ-PROV-005).
reorganisationPlanDocument.title: Reorganisatieplan Document

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Herstructureringsvoorziening Detail is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

GarantievoorzieningDetail.title: Garantievoorziening Detail
GarantievoorzieningDetail.description: Type-specific detail register for garantievoorzieningen (REQ-PROV-012). FK back to a Provision with provisionType=garantie. Best estimate is derived from historical claim rates × revenue base per product category.

productCategories.description: Product categories covered by the warranty provision (REQ-PROV-012).
productCategories.title: Product Categories

historicalClaimRate.description: Historical claim rate as a decimal fraction of revenue (REQ-PROV-012).
historicalClaimRate.title: Historical Claim Rate

revenueBaseInPeriod.description: Revenue base in EUR over which the historical claim rate applies (REQ-PROV-012).
revenueBaseInPeriod.title: Revenue Base In Period

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Garantievoorziening Detail is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

MilieuvoorzieningDetail.title: Milieuvoorziening Detail
MilieuvoorzieningDetail.description: Type-specific detail register for milieuvoorzieningen (REQ-PROV-013). FK back to a Provision with provisionType=milieu. Captures contamination location, regulatory framework (Wbb / Wm / EU-IED), expert consultant, legally required completion date and whether the obligation includes an ontmantelingsverplichting for IAS 16 §16(c) component activation.

cleanupEstimate.description: Cleanup estimate in EUR per the expert report (REQ-PROV-013).
cleanupEstimate.title: Cleanup Estimate

legallyRequiredCompletionDate.description: Legally required completion date for the remediation (REQ-PROV-013).
legallyRequiredCompletionDate.title: Legally Required Completion Date

phasedExecutionPlan.description: Free-form description of the phased execution plan (REQ-PROV-013).
phasedExecutionPlan.title: Phased Execution Plan

decommissioningCommitment.description: Whether the obligation includes an ontmantelingsverplichting, in which case the cost is capitalised as a component of MVA per IAS 16 §16(c) / IFRS 16 (REQ-PROV-013).
decommissioningCommitment.title: Ontmantelings Verplichting

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Milieuvoorziening Detail is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

ClaimsVoorzieningDetail.title: Claims Voorziening Detail
ClaimsVoorzieningDetail.description: Type-specific detail register for claims- en geschillen-voorzieningen (IAS 37 §37, REQ-PROV-006). FK back to a Provision with provisionType=claims. legalAdviceMemo is mandatory and stored under restricted access (CFO / audit committee / accountant only) to preserve legal privilege. The activation guard blocks status=active when the memo FK is missing.

amountClaimed.description: Amount claimed by the plaintiff in EUR (REQ-PROV-006).
amountClaimed.title: Amount Claimed

bestEstimateSettlement.description: Best estimate of the settlement amount in EUR per the legal advice memo (REQ-PROV-006).
bestEstimateSettlement.title: Best Estimate Settlement

legalAdviceMemo.description: FK into docudesk for the legal advice memo. Stored under restricted access (CFO, audit committee, accountant only) per attorney-client privilege (REQ-PROV-006). Required: the activation guard blocks status=active when missing.
legalAdviceMemo.title: Legal Advice Memo

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Claims Voorziening Detail is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).

ProvisionDisclosureTabel.title: Provision Disclosure Table
ProvisionDisclosureTabel.description: Auto-generated jaarrekening disclosure table per IAS 37 §85 / RJ 252 §408 (REQ-PROV-008). Aggregates Provision + ProvisionMovement + ContingentLiability records into a single structured record per period per provisionType (header: count + total opening; movement table per Provision; contingent-liability section; materiality narrative > EUR 100K / > 1% balanstotaal; sensitivity narrative from rangeLow / rangeHigh).

count.description: Number of provisions of this type in the period (REQ-PROV-008).
count.title: Count

openingBalance.description: Sum of openingBalance across all ProvisionMovement records of this type (REQ-PROV-008).
openingBalance.title: Opening Balance

additions.description: Sum of additions across all ProvisionMovement records of this type (REQ-PROV-008).
additions.title: Additions

used.description: Sum of usedDuringPeriod across all ProvisionMovement records of this type (REQ-PROV-008).
used.title: Used

released.description: Sum of releasedUnused across all ProvisionMovement records of this type (REQ-PROV-008).
released.title: Released

unwinding.description: Sum of unwindingOfDiscount across all ProvisionMovement records of this type (REQ-PROV-008).
unwinding.title: Unwinding

estimatesChange.description: Sum of effectOfChangeInEstimate across all ProvisionMovement records of this type (REQ-PROV-008, REQ-PROV-019).
estimatesChange.title: Estimates Change

closingBalance.description: Sum of closingBalance across all ProvisionMovement records of this type (REQ-PROV-008).
closingBalance.title: Closing Balance

narrative.description: Materiality + sensitivity narrative for the jaarrekening note (REQ-PROV-002, REQ-PROV-008, REQ-PROV-018).
narrative.example: Garantievoorziening EUR 75K per 31 december 2026, waarvan EUR 45K in 2026 is gebruikt voor reparaties. Sensitivity EUR 80K–150K op basis van 1.0%–2.5% claim-rate variantie.
narrative.title: Narrative

contingentLiabilitySection.description: Narrative covering ContingentLiability disclosures for this type (REQ-PROV-015).
contingentLiabilitySection.title: Contingent Liability Section

administrationId.description: FK to the administration; reads scoped to the requesting user's administration.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

provisionDisclosureGeneration.description: Declarative shape of the disclosure-table generation (REQ-PROV-008). Joins ProvisionMovement records per provisionType per period, computes the sum buckets and emits one ProvisionDisclosureTabel per (period, provisionType). When the engine cannot template the merge, the same arithmetic is rebuilt from ProvisionMovement + ContingentLiability via the real ObjectService API.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Provision Disclosure Table is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp (REQ-AT-001).
